messages:
jordan: hey team :wave: first day here — trying to finish observability setup for infra-service. i can view dashboards in Grafana but the Edit button is disabled. also getting 'Project not found' when opening Sentry for infra-service. who do i ping to get the right perms?

maya: welcome @jordan! for Grafana edit rights open the access portal (see bot below) and request Grafana Editor with team tag eng-infra. for Sentry, @elena usually invites folks to projects. quick check: are you on the redwood org SSO account or did you sign up with an alternate email?

elena: hi @jordan — i can invite you to the Sentry project. i need the email you used for SSO and the exact project slug/name. sometimes folks see "Project not found" if they're in a different org or not part of the prod team. send me the email here or DM.

jordan: sending via DM: jordan@redwood.dev. project name is infra-service-prod (i copied it from the onboarding checklist). i did sign in with SSO.

samira: re: Grafana edit perms, note that we moved ownership of infra dashboards under the "platform-dashboards" folder. editors need both folder-level edit and dashboard-specific rights. once you have editor role you'll see the Alerting button. if you want to reduce alert noise for CPU, please open a tiny PR in the alerts repo with the proposed threshold change so SRE can review.

devex-bot: To request Grafana edit rights: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> choose "Grafana Editor" -> add team tag "eng-infra" -> include justification e.g. "onboarding: infra-service dashboard edits, reduce alert noise". Typical approval: 1-2 business days. For expedited access react with :rocket: or ping #eng-oncall with justification.

eng-oncall: @jordan if this is causing production alert storms, please put "prod-impact" in the request and CC @eng-oncall. we can temporarily mute noisy rules while you make changes. also share the dashboard link here once you have edit rights so we can approve small edits quickly.

jordan: submitted access request with prod-impact and linked this thread. also left a note in the alerts repo mentioning the CPU panel id. thanks all!

maya: awesome — once elena sends the Sentry invite you should be able to see events and traces. welcome aboard! drop any follow-ups here or DM if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
